player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Blackjack ne dealer no.
Wo botae ne sɛ wo bɛkɔ 21 nkyɛn na wo annyɛ n'akyi.
Wo dwumadie, wo nsa '[Hit]' sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo gye ka no foforo anaa '[Stand]' sɛ wo pɛ sɛ wo gyae.
J/Q/K = 10 pɔinti; A = 11 anaa 1, nea ɛyɛ papa no.
